about: The vehicle kit's armoury (docs/vehiclekit/VEHICLEKIT.md, 'The armoury'; Source/VehicleKit/VehicleArmoury.cs). Each recipe is a turret gun in the weapon builder's own text (receiver{socket:part,...}; a splitter's barrels as barrel_N, a muzzle device as {muzzle:...} on its barrel), fitted through the game's build rules, so a player could build every one. merge: 1 a single receiver, 2 or 3 an NxN square of that receiver merged into one N times the size (ReceiverMerge.json: damage N^2 a shot, fire rate / N). box: what feeds it (null: a flame gun, which drinks the vehicle's fuel). class: light, medium or heavy (the roles weigh guns by it). tier: the least threat tier it is common at (below it, a tenth as likely). tags: what it is for (light, medium, heavy, boss, aa, anti-armour, close, suppress, flame, oddity). mount: pintle (open), shield (a gun shield on the arm), twin (two receivers side by side, one gunner). inspired: the Zombies mystery box builds (Parts/Builds) it is taken from. factions: style name -> [weight 1 to 6 (copies in the style's list; each own gun is 1), the faction's name for it]. --check-armoury fits and checks every recipe.

recipes.about: Four rifle receivers bolted into a square: one receiver twice the size on a heavy bore, four rifles' punch a shot at half the rate.
recipes.build: Workhorse Receiver{barrel:Heavy Bore Barrel,feed:Extended Mag,action:Full-Auto Sear}

recipes.about: A merged rifle block on a stub barrel with a brake: short, loud and ugly, the Bandits' cheapest cannon.
recipes.build: Workhorse Receiver{barrel:Stub Barrel{muzzle:Muzzle Brake},feed:Drum Mag,action:Full-Auto Sear}

recipes.about: Four battle rifles merged, semi-automatic on a long barrel: a slow, hard-hitting gun for anything with plates.
recipes.build: Reaper Battle Rifle Receiver{barrel:Long Barrel{muzzle:Muzzle Brake},feed:Extended Mag,action:Semi-Auto Trigger}

recipes.about: Four LMG actions merged into a heavy machine gun on a heatsink barrel: the standard heavy MG.

recipes.about: Four pump receivers merged into a deck gun that fires a bucket of shot: close defence for a big vehicle.

recipes.about: Four carbines merged on a standard barrel: a quick, light cannon a small crew can afford.

recipes.about: Four marksman actions merged behind a fluted barrel: a precise long-range anti-armour gun.
